flags.question: Which 3 users amplified Neo4j the most?

MATCH (me:Me)<-[:AMPLIFIES]-(u:User)
RETURN u.screen_name AS user, count(*) AS amplifications
ORDER BY amplifications DESC
LIMIT 3
